title: Holding Several Car Rentals at Once
content:
A renter may hold any number of car rentals at the same time, including overlapping rentals in different
cities, and each rental carries its own rate class and its own ledger. There is no ceiling on the number of
Car Rental Rate Classes bookings one renter may hold.

## What is never aggregated

Nothing is aggregated between rentals. Included mileage, protection products and free additional drivers
belong to the rental that carries them and are never moved. A driver named on two rentals at once is still
one driver, and the young or senior driver charge is charged on each rental separately.

## Duplicate review before collection

Two rentals with the same supplier, the same collection branch and overlapping times are referred for
duplicate review before collection, because a supplier holds one vehicle against one driver. All three
marks must coincide for the referral to arise: the same supplier, the same collection branch, and times
that overlap.

| Second rental against the first | Same supplier | Same collection branch | Times overlap | Referred for duplicate review |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Different supplier, same branch, same days | no | yes | yes | no |
| Same supplier, different city branch, same days | yes | no | yes | no |
| Same supplier, same branch, consecutive weeks | yes | yes | no | no |
| Same supplier, same branch, same days | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Two readings of the table

Two overlapping rentals in different cities are ordinary and are not referred, because their branches
differ. A renter holding a rental on the Pay Now Saver Rate and another on the Inclusive Flex Rate holds two
rate classes and two ledgers, and the free additional driver carried by the second does not answer for a
driver named on the first.
